Chapter 503: Chapter 7 Heading to Demon Jade Space (Request for Subscription)_2

Lin Yuan’s face broke into a smile.

Although in the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan had cultivated several Seventh Stage Martial Tao warriors.

But that had taken nearly a thousand years. That the Main World had produced such Martial Path Evolutionaries in just a few decades was extremely rare.

In terms of efficiency, it completely overshadowed the number of Martial Tao cultivators the Spirit Realm could train in the same period.

“I set the price of the Eighth Layer Part at five hundred billion civilization coins, and it sold over ten thousand copies?” Lin Yuan glanced at the sales figures of the Eighth Layer Part.

Those buying the Eighth Layer Part at this time were basically not Evolvers on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

...

After all, Evolvers on the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path hadn’t even reached the Sixth Rank, so buying the Eighth Layer Part was pointless.

It was likely those Eighth, Ninth, and even Tenth Rank Evolvers who bought it casually.

After all, the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path ranked first in the Annan Star Alliance Evolution rankings, and its soaring speed meant that even if Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers couldn’t use it, they wouldn’t mind buying it to take a look.

Five hundred billion civilization coins, a huge fortune for Sixth and Seventh Rank Evolvers, didn’t count for much in the eyes of Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers.

Ninth and Tenth Rank Evolvers, already belonging to the strategic forces of human civilization, could easily amass far more than this amount with just one foray into a Cosmic Secret Realm.

“With over ten thousand copies of the Eighth Layer Part sold, even after subtracting the share for human civilization and taxes, I still have thousands of Cubic Universe Crystals in hand.”

Lin Yuan’s spirits were lifted. This was just a short time after he had uploaded the Eighth Layer Part— the income it would bring him from the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was only going to increase.

…

Inside the Chikun Prime Virtual World.

Lin Yuan sat opposite the Chikun Starlord, savoring fine wine.

“It’s been a long time since I’ve had such leisure to enjoy a drink,” Lin Yuan said, sipping gently, the hot sensation flowing down his throat.

The wine in the Virtual World, although non-beneficial to the physical body, tasted no different from real fine wines.

“This wine, out there, costs a Cubic Universe Crystal per glass. It’s much cheaper in the Virtual World, but still millions of cosmos coins,” said the Chikun Starlord, who, even for him, could not bear to buy such expensive wines in reality—not because he couldn’t afford it, but because he found it too painful.

“The three cosmic forces you used to defeat those two invincible Eighth Rank beings, were they all higher cosmic forces?” the Chikun Starlord also took a sip and asked curiously.

“I’m not sure if they were higher cosmic forces,” Lin Yuan shook his head.

He only speculated that the Taiji Force, Destruction Force, and Immeasurable Force were higher cosmic forces, but he didn’t really know.

“Teacher, take a look,” Lin Yuan raised his right hand, three strands of energy swirling between his fingers.

“Indeed, they are higher cosmic forces. With this strand of cosmic force, you’ve at least cultivated to the Third Realm,” the Chikun Starlord said in awe.

He had already seen the video of Lin Yuan in action, noticing his disciple mobilizing three types of cosmic forces, but seeing the three higher cosmic forces obediently winding around his disciple’s fingers was still somewhat shocking.

This was higher cosmic force,

Not some roadside green vegetable.

“People cannot be compared with one another; I was so proud when I realized one type of cosmic force, but my disciple, you comprehended three types of higher cosmic forces all at once…” the Chikun Starlord said wistfully.

“It was good luck, just happened to comprehend three types of powers, all of which were cosmic forces,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

In the Main World Universe Starry Sky, cosmic forces cannot be simulated or replicated, so realizing a type of cosmic force is very much about luck.

Some Eighth Rank powerhouses may spend tens of thousands of years without realizing a type of cosmic force, while some might achieve it in just a few decades.

It all depends on random factors.

“To discover one might be luck, but to discover three and still call it luck?” the Chikun Starlord sighed.

His disciple was excellent in all aspects, except he was too humble.

If it was himself, he would have boasted to all his old friends.

“Three types of higher cosmic forces… When you step into the Ninth Rank, forging a Ninth Rank foundation, how solid will it be?” the Chikun Starlord remarked admiringly.

What the Chikun Starlord did not know, was that his disciple didn’t just comprehend three types of cosmic forces, but dozens of them.

Some even included the Primal Force, which surpassed higher cosmic forces.

…

In the Red Kun Lineage Virtual World.

Countless members of the Red Kun Lineage were whispering, their gazes occasionally turning towards the imposing main peak at the center.

The well-informed members had long known that the Thirteen Peaks Master, also known as the Galaxy Master, was currently meeting with the Chikun Starlord.

The Galaxy Master… Previously, people wouldn’t have been so excited, but news of the Galaxy Master defeating two invincible Eighth Rank beings of a Different Species in the Fringe Starfield had come.

That news had exploded amongst all members of the Red Kun Lineage.

Accomplishing what not even the Chikun Starlord had achieved, the Galaxy Master had thoroughly excited the members of the Red Kun Lineage.

Anyone could see, with such young achievements in defeating invincible Eighth Ranks, stepping into the Ninth Rank was inevitable.

“How is the Thirteen Peaks Master so powerful?”

“Hehe, over the years, has the Thirteen Peaks master created few miracles?”

“Had I known, I would have done everything to join the Thirteen Peaks and become a subordinate of the Thirteen Peaks master.”

“Do you think you can get in just by giving it your all? The Thirteen Peaks are extremely selective in their recruitment.”

Members of the Red Kun Lineage eagerly discussed, and the prestige of the Galaxy Master began to spread throughout the Southern Star Region of human civilization.

Consequently, the Red Kun Lineage also gained fame.

…

A corner within the Red Kun Lineage.

Feng Yu gazed distantly at the central main peak, his expression complex.

Originally, during the Seven Star Cave test, the Thirteen Peaks master had invited him to join the Thirteen Peaks.

He had rejected the offer, choosing instead a Great Peak Master who had already advanced to the Eighth Layer.

Not long after, Feng Yu came to regret this decision as the Thirteen Peaks master also advanced to the Eighth Layer.

Compared to the Great Peak Master, who had taken nearly a hundred thousand years to reach the Eighth Layer, the Thirteen Peaks master surpassed the former in every aspect.

At the time, Feng Yu had chosen the Great Peak Master because he had already been a powerful Eighth Layer fighter, but soon after, the Thirteen Peaks master also advanced to the Eighth Layer.

This made Feng Yu feel like a fool.

Over the years, Feng Yu had gradually come to terms with his choice.

He thought that even if he hadn’t joined the Thirteen Peaks, becoming a subordinate of the Great Peak Master, it wouldn’t have mattered much.

That was until he recently heard that the Thirteen Peaks master had slain two Eighth Layer invincible alien races.

Those were Eighth Layer invincible alien races.

And they were just killed by the Thirteen Peaks master?

Feng Yu felt extreme regret, thinking that had he chosen the Thirteen Peaks at that time, he would now be a highly sought-after figure.

In that session of the Seven Star Cave test, the two Evolvers who had chosen the Thirteen Peaks, Mo Li being a powerhouse as a Red Patternn Examiner, was already stronger than him, Feng Yu.

But Wu Lan?

Just an ordinary Silver Pattern.

With no background.

With no support.

Merely because she had accepted the invitation of the Thirteen Peaks master.

Now, she was held in high regard among the Red Kun Lineage, even receiving respect from several of the peak masters.

“One wrong step leads to many,” Feng Yu sighed inwardly.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

After chatting with his teacher, the Chikun Starlord, for a while,

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World.

“Now, I should be at the peak of the Eighth Layer,” Lin Yuan thought to himself, having completed the entire Eighth Stage of Martial Arts, which marked the end of his journey in the Eighth Layer, and what remained was breaking through to the Ninth Layer.

“I might try exploring the Demon Jade Space…” Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

After deriving three thousand three hundred and thirty-three evolutionary pathways from the body of a Supreme Being from beyond the cosmos,

A Magic Jade Mark automatically formed deep within Lin Yuan’s soul, making him an ordinary member of the Moyu Tower.

The Magic Jade Mark, aside from being a symbol of a regular member of the Moyu Tower and stabilizing the spirit will,

also connected to a mysterious space—the Demon Jade Space, fashioned by the Demonic Jade Tower Master.

This very space held the greatest opportunity within the body of the deceased Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan found out from the Magic Jade Mark that it’s best to consider entering the Demon Jade Space at the peak of the Eighth Layer.

Thus, he waited until today.

“Now, I can do it.”

Lin Yuan probed his soul with his mind, locking onto the ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’ shaped Magic Jade Mark.

“Let’s explore.”

Lin Yuan activated the Nine Floors Dark Tower mark, and in an instant, his will climbed immeasurably, arriving in a mysterious space.
